d: Where does the training data for AI agents come from? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, John Yang, co-creator of SWE-bench and SWE-agent, explains what data agents need (traces, demonstrations, and feedback), data for optimization vs. evaluation, data flywheels, and why agents need environments and not just web text. He covers the difference between trajectories and environments, how to verify agent work, and strategies for collecting agent data: human demonstrations, mining the web, synthetic data generation (LLM-synthesized trajectories and tasks like SWE-smith and…
